personas.client: buys what is getting attention: stocks with big recent moves, heavy trading and fresh news.
wants a chance at a big win: cheap, volatile stocks whose returns can jump a long way.
follows trends: stocks that have risen strongly and steadily over the past year.
buys the dip: stocks that have fallen recently and look oversold.
wants steady income: stable, profitable companies that pay and grow dividends.
buys what they know: large, well-established companies.

agents.name: Rules reader
agents.does: Reads the finals rules and quotes every limit word for word
agents.finding: Read 15 rules in the finals PDFs and 13 match the fund's limits, 2 misfile the net band

agents.name: Triage
agents.does: Labels each 8-K the book's companies filed as good, bad or neutral news
agents.finding: Labelled 991 8-Ks from the book's names and 44% of the non-neutral news favoured our side

agents.name: Analyst
agents.does: Reads the latest filing of the book's ten largest longs and ten largest shorts
agents.finding: Read the latest report of 20 top names, 8 support our side, 12 are mixed and 0 challenge it

agents.name: Devil's advocate
agents.does: Attacks the final book, and code checks every number it quotes
agents.finding: Made 9 attacks on the final book and the data shows 7 stand in whole or in part

agents.name: Memo writer
agents.does: Writes the August investor letter, and code checks every number in it
agents.finding: The August letter reports $1.467bn against the $1.509bn hurdle and an IR of -0.11

agents.name: Explainer
agents.does: Says why the book holds a name, from the facts it was shown
agents.finding: Explained 40 top positions in 33 answers and 33 of 33 traced every number

agents.name: Risk desk
agents.does: Writes the risk note on the final book, with every number and level set by code
agents.finding: Raised 13 flags on the final book, 0 alert and 5 watch, with no finals limit broken

agents.name: AI crowd
agents.does: Plays retail stock pickers on anonymous stock cards
agents.finding: On the final book our longs sit at the AI crowd's 58th percentile and shorts at the 57th, crowd beta 0.09
